_about: Court cases this site follows by name: their docket entries go into the policy feed (scripts/ingest_court_dockets.py). Add a case by its CourtListener docket id (the number in its docket's address), with a short name that names no private person, the court as the feed shows it, and one sentence on why it matters. Set stopped: true to stop reading one; its stored filings stay.

dockets.court: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
dockets.about: The case over the State Department's 75-country immigrant visa pause, which the court struck down on August 21, 2026, and where State has reported under oath on its worldwide immigrant visa interview pause.
dockets.topicsText: immigrant visa green card consular processing public charge

dockets.court: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit
dockets.about: The government's appeal of the ruling that struck down the 75-country immigrant visa pause. On October 19, 2026 the appeals court paused the part of the ruling that sent old refusals back for review.
dockets.topicsText: immigrant visa green card consular processing

dockets.court: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York
